description: This file defines a collection of types, functions, and methods for managing toolsets, including error handling, registration, grouping, and scope filtering within an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server environment.

classes.name: ToolsetDoesNotExistError
classes.description: Custom error type for non-existent toolsets.

classes.name: ServerTool
classes.description: Represents a server tool with registration functionality.

classes.name: ServerResourceTemplate
classes.description: Associates a resource template with its handler.

classes.name: ServerPrompt
classes.description: Associates a prompt with its handler.

classes.name: Toolset
classes.description: A collection of MCP tools, resources, and prompts, with methods for registration and configuration.

classes.name: ToolsetGroup
classes.description: A group of toolsets, managing their enabled state, registration, and alias resolution.

classes.name: ToolsetMetadata
classes.description: Metadata for a toolset, including ID and description.

classes.name: ToolsetRegistry
classes.description: Registry holding toolset definitions, tools, resources, and prompts, with methods to create toolset groups.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns error string for ToolsetDoesNotExistError.

methods.name: Is
methods.description: Checks if the error matches ToolsetDoesNotExistError.

methods.name: NewServerTool
methods.description: Creates a new ServerTool with a handler that unmarshals arguments and calls the provided handler.

methods.name: NewServerResourceTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new ServerResourceTemplate with a resource template and handler.

methods.name: NewServerPrompt
methods.description: Creates a new ServerPrompt with a prompt and handler.

methods.name: GetActiveTools
methods.description: Returns active tools based on enabled and read-only status.

methods.name: GetAvailableTools
methods.description: Returns available tools, considering read-only status.

methods.name: RegisterTools
methods.description: Registers read and write tools with the server if enabled.

methods.name: AddResourceTemplates
methods.description: Adds resource templates to the toolset.

methods.name: AddPrompts
methods.description: Adds prompts to the toolset.

methods.name: GetActiveResourceTemplates
methods.description: Returns active resource templates if enabled.

methods.name: GetAvailableResourceTemplates
methods.description: Returns all resource templates.

methods.name: RegisterResourcesTemplates
methods.description: Registers resource templates with the server.

methods.name: RegisterPrompts
methods.description: Registers prompts with the server.

methods.name: SetReadOnly
methods.description: Sets the toolset to read-only mode.

methods.name: AddWriteTools
methods.description: Adds write tools to the toolset, panics if tools are incorrectly annotated.

methods.name: AddReadTools
methods.description: Adds read tools to the toolset, panics if tools are not annotated as read-only.

methods.name: NewToolsetGroup
methods.description: Creates a new ToolsetGroup with specified read-only status.

methods.name: NewToolset
methods.description: Creates a new Toolset with name and description.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a toolset is enabled.

methods.name: EnableToolsets
methods.description: Enables multiple toolsets, with optional error on unknown.

methods.name: EnableToolset
methods.description: Enables a specific toolset by name.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all tools, resources, and prompts in the group.

methods.name: GetToolset
methods.description: Retrieves a toolset by name.

methods.name: AddDeprecatedToolAliases
methods.description: Adds deprecated aliases for tools.

methods.name: AddToolset
methods.description: Adds a toolset to the group.

methods.name: ResolveToolAliases
methods.description: Resolves deprecated tool aliases to canonical names, logs warnings.

methods.name: FindToolByName
methods.description: Finds a tool by name across all toolsets.

methods.name: RegisterSpecificTools
methods.description: Registers specified tools, respecting read-only mode, logs skipped tools.
